front_blocks.md: State the equation for ***A***<sub>**r**</sub> in terms of the percentage abundance and mass of isotopes A and B. **(Extended Tier Only)**

back_blocks.md: The equation for calculating relative atomic mass in terms of the percentage abundance and mass of isotopes A and B is:
$\frac{( \% of \text{isotope} \mathrm{A} \mathrm{x} \text{mass} of \text{isotope} \mathrm{A} ) + ( \% of \text{isotope} \mathrm{B} \mathrm{x} \text{mass} of \text{isotope} \mathrm{B} )}{100}$
